proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Prove injectivity of the base change map to the limit by putting pairs of cycles mapping to the same element into the closed equal locus and descending into it along the inverse system using the constructible containment lemma, then prove surjectivity by pulling the given relative cycle into the image of the cycle-classes construction over a completely decomposed proper cover, descend the covering morphism and the flat closed subschemes to some finite level with the descending machinery of the Limits chapter including the descent of completely decomposed morphisms, compare the two pullbacks of the descended cycle class to the double base change and make them equal after increasing the index by the injectivity part, descend uniquely along the completely decomposed cover with the descent lemma for families and land in the group of relative cycles by the h-descent lemma, and conclude the descended cycle maps back to the given one by uniqueness (source lines 1396-1460)

core_obligations: Prove z(X/S, r) = colim z(X_i/S_i, r) for S the limit of a directed inverse system of Noetherian schemes with affine transition morphisms and S Noetherian (proof lines 1396-1460). Injectivity: suppose alpha_i and beta_i in z(X_i/S_i, r) map to the same element of z(X/S, r); the morphism S to S_i maps into the closed subset E of lemma-relative-cycles-equal (tag 0H5C) on which the two families agree, so by limits-lemma-limit-contained-in-constructible (tag 05F4) some transition morphism S_j to S_i maps into E, whence the base changes of alpha_i and beta_i to S_j agree (proof lines 1397-1405). Surjectivity: given alpha in z(X/S, r), apply lemma-get-cycles (tag 0H59) to obtain a completely decomposed proper morphism g : S' to S with g^*alpha in the image of equation-cycle-classes (tag 0H58), and write g^*alpha = sum n_a [Z_a/X'/S']_r with the Z_a closed subschemes of X' flat of relative dimension at most r over S' (proof lines 1407-1413); using the descending machinery of Limits, Section limits-section-descending-relative (tag 01ZL), find an index i together with a completely decomposed proper morphism g_i : S'_i to S_i whose base change to S is g and closed subschemes Z_{ai} of X'_i flat of relative dimension at most r over S'_i whose base changes to S' are the Z_a, using limits-lemma-descend-finite-presentation (tag 01ZM), limits-lemma-descend-closed-immersion-finite-presentation (tag 01ZP), limits-lemma-descend-flat-finite-presentation (tag 04AI), limits-lemma-eventually-proper (tag 081F), limits-lemma-limit-dimension (tag 05M5), and more-morphisms-lemma-descend-cd (tag 0GTM) (proof lines 1415-1434); set alpha'_i = sum n_a [Z_{ai}/X'_i/S'_i]_r, whose image in z(X'/S', r) agrees with g^*alpha by construction (proof lines 1435-1438); the two pullbacks pr_1^*alpha'_i and pr_2^*alpha'_i map to the same element of z(X''/S'', r) because their limit images agree, so after increasing i they are equal by the injectivity paragraph (proof lines 1440-1450); by lemma-descend-family (tag 0H4X) there is a unique family alpha_i of r-cycles on fibres of X_i/S_i with g_i^*alpha_i = alpha'_i, using that S'_i to S_i is completely decomposed, and by lemma-relative-cycles-h-descent (tag 0H52) alpha_i lies in z(X_i/S_i, r); the uniqueness part of lemma-descend-family implies the image of alpha_i in z(X/S, r) is alpha, completing the proof (proof lines 1451-1459).
proof_roadmap: Injectivity: put pairs mapping to the same limit element into the closed equal locus and descend into it along the system via the constructible containment lemma (proof lines 1397-1405).
Reduction to image cycles: pull alpha into the image of the cycle-classes construction over a completely decomposed proper cover (proof lines 1407-1413).
Descend the cover and the flat subschemes to a finite level with the Limits descending machinery and the descent of completely decomposed morphisms (proof lines 1415-1438).

Equate the two pullbacks after increasing the index by injectivity, descend uniquely along the cover with the families descent lemma, promote to z(X_i/S_i, r) by h-descent, and conclude the image is alpha (proof lines 1440-1459).
